test_title: PYST 55: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only three people sit between R and T when counted from the left of R. Only three people sit between B and A when counted from the right of A.S sits to the immediate right of B. U is an immediate neighbour of A as well as T. Who sits to the second to the left of C?
solution:
**Given:**

→ A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

→ Only three people sit between R and T when counted from the left of R.

→ Only three people sit between B and A when counted from the right of A.

→ S sits to the immediate right of B.

→ U is an immediate neighbour of both A and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4324e0cec400c15bf4d6452d83f18aecf4026186e3028083b13ccfd2ca541453.png] 

From C, move two places left:

→ First left = T

→ Second left = U

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3 - U".**
